description: baseline: LightGBM with 60-trial Optuna TPO search (5-fold CV) — optimal for small tabular binary classification at N=891 with mixed numeric/categorical features

Enhanced feature engineering (ticket group size, title-based age imputation, WomanOrChild flag, cabin number, fare per ticket member) + added CatBoost with native categorical handling, ensembled 50/50 with LightGBM OOF predictions
Added Title-based age imputation, AgeIsNull flag, WomanOrChild and AgeSexMale interaction features, plus 5-seed LightGBM ensemble averaging to reduce prediction variance

Added XGBoost to ensemble (LightGBM leaf-wise vs XGBoost depth-wise creates complementary predictions), plus new features: TicketGroupSize, CabinNum, FarePclassRank, SexClass interaction; blend 5-seed LightGBM + 5-seed XGBoost OOF predictions 50/50

Added TicketGroupSize/IsTicketGroup (same-ticket group proxy), SurnameGroupSize (surname family proxy), CabinNum (numeric cabin ordinal), WCPclass interaction; added max_depth to Optuna HPO; switched ensemble from same-fold-different-model-seed to 5-repeat-5-fold CV (different fold splits per seed for true prediction diversity)

Added fold-aware cross-validated target encoding: FamilySurvRate (surname group) and TicketSurvRate (ticket group) computed with Bayesian smoothing (k=3) and LOO for training samples — families tend to survive/die together, making this one of the strongest Titanic signals not yet in the model

Added fold-aware target encodings for DeckSurvRate and PclassSexSurvRate (the strongest Titanic interaction: 1st class female ~97% vs 3rd class male ~13%), plus TicketGroupSize/SurnameGroupSize group count features and WCPclass interaction; increased Optuna to 100 trials

Added TicketGroupSize, SurnameGroupSize, IsAloneTicket (group count features that tell the model how reliable the survival rate encodings are), WCPclass interaction (WomanOrChild × Pclass captures 1st-class women ~97% vs 3rd-class women ~50%), max_depth to Optuna HPO for better regularization tuning, increased trials to 100, and expanded ensemble seeds from 5 to 7 for better variance reduction.

Added CatBoost (5-seed, 5-fold OOF, native categoricals + fold-aware survival features) blended 50/50 with LightGBM — algorithmic diversity from CatBoost's symmetric trees and ordered boosting vs LightGBM's leaf-wise growth should reduce ensemble variance beyond what multi-seed LightGBM alone achieves

Added fold-aware PclassSexSurvRate target encoding (6 Pclass×Sex groups with survival rates from ~97% to ~13%) as a third survival feature alongside FamilySurvRate and TicketSurvRate, keeping all other settings identical to exp 6

Added SurnameGroupSize, TicketGroupSize, IsAloneFamily, IsAloneTicket as count features (no target leakage) — these provide reliability signals for the fold-aware survival rate encodings: a singleton's FamilySurvRate/TicketSurvRate equals global mean (low confidence) while a group of 4 is strongly informative; all other exp 6 settings unchanged

Added smooth_k (Bayesian smoothing intensity for survival rate encodings) as an Optuna hyperparameter (0.5–10.0 log scale) so the encoding regularization is jointly tuned with model params, plus added WCPclass=WomanOrChild×Pclass interaction capturing the 1st-class vs 3rd-class female/child survival difference; increased Optuna trials to 100

Added `SurvRateProduct = FamilySurvRate × TicketSurvRate` as a fold-aware derived feature (explicit multiplicative interaction capturing when both survival signals agree), and expanded ensemble from 5 to 7 seeds for lower OOF variance — no new leakage risk, no extra Optuna parameters to dilute the HPO search

Added social-group connected-components (union-find over surname+ticket edges) as a third fold-aware survival rate encoding (SocialGroupSurvRate) plus its size indicators (SocialGroupSize, IsAloneSocial); also added FarePerTicketMember (correct per-person fare using TicketGroupSize) and LogTicketNum (ticket number proxy for cabin section)

Added ExtraTrees (3-seed, 5-fold OOF, n_estimators=500, min_samples_leaf=2, class_weight='balanced') blended 80% LightGBM + 20% ExtraTrees — bagging with random thresholds provides fundamentally different variance structure than sequential gradient boosting, using a conservative 80/20 weight to limit downside risk vs. previous 50/50 ensembles that hurt

Replaced 1-best-params×5-seeds ensemble with top-5-Optuna-params×3-seeds (15 models total) to gain hyperparameter diversity on top of seed diversity, reducing ensemble correlation for better variance reduction

Multi-seed Optuna HPO (3 independent studies × 35 trials) for hyperparameter space diversity + repeated K-fold ensemble (3 fold random states × 3 model seeds × 5 configs = 45 models) to reduce OOF estimation variance via different fold structure assignments

Added WCPclass = WomanOrChild × Pclass interaction feature — explicitly pre-computes the most important Titanic survival pattern (1st-class female/child ~97% vs 3rd-class ~50% vs adult male ~20%) so it's always available in every LightGBM feature subset regardless of feature_fraction sampling

Added FareRankInClass (fare percentile rank within Pclass) as a new feature — within each class, higher fare correlates with better deck/cabin position (closer to lifeboats), providing a cabin quality proxy orthogonal to absolute LogFare and Pclass that the model cannot easily learn through multi-level splits alone
